exposure: Mode of delivery (Caesarean section vs. vaginal delivery)
cohort: 1850 adolescents at the age of 15 years, who participated in a follow-up examination of the GINIplus study.
finding: Caesarean section delivery was not associated with impaired lung function or an increased risk of asthma at age 15 in this cohort of healthy full-term neonates.
mod_finding: The study found no significant association between Cesarean Section delivery and impaired lung function or an increased risk of asthma at the age of 15 in a cohort of healthy full-term neonates.
